C2_pan_while_zoomed_contradiction.verdict: OUR earlier PASS was correct. The Gate 3 panel's 'dead, byte-identical' finding does not hold against direct code reading or against a correctly-driven repro; it was reproduced only via demonstrable test-harness defects.
C2_pan_while_zoomed_contradiction.summary: handlePinchMove (TownGrid.tsx ~line 489) has no branch that requires distance/scale to change before translate updates -- the anchor-preserving translate math runs off midX/midY deltas alone whenever nextScale > fitScale. Every frozen-transform reproduction we obtained traced to the touch gesture never being seen as a 2-pointer gesture at all (a reused CDP touch-point id that Chromium silently dropped, or a fixed screen coordinate that fell outside the already-zoomed grid's live bounding box) -- not to the app ignoring a genuine constant-separation drag. When both fingers were verified registered and kept inside the grid's live box, translate moved on every step, never frozen. Secondary (smaller, separately flagged) real bug found along the way: same-tick dual pointermove handling reads a stale getBoundingClientRect() inside the chained setPinch functional updater, causing measurable scale/translate drift/jitter during a pan -- not fixed, reported only.

C5_rapid_submit_and_edge_amounts.notes: 3 native click events dispatched synchronously on the real 저장 button DOM node (bypassing Playwright's serialized-click waits, to genuinely test near-simultaneous taps) with amount=5,000/카테고리=식비: building count went 0->1, not 0->3 -- the savedRef in-flight guard (EntrySheet.tsx) correctly blocks duplicate submits for a VALID amount too, not only the previously-tested empty-amount case.
